description: Contoso Bank SRE Demo — monitors application health, infrastructure, database, and business metrics. Designed for chaos engineering demonstrations with Azure SRE Agent.

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: Total HTTP requests per second across all endpoints

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = count() / 300.0

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: Percentage of HTTP requests returning 5xx status codes

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize total = count(), errors = countif(ResultCode startswith "5")
| project error_rate = iff(total == 0, 0.0, errors * 100.0 / total)

panels.title: P95 Latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request latency across all endpoints

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = percentile(DurationMs, 95) / 1000.0

AppMetrics
| where Name == "http.server.active_requests"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = avg(Sum)

panels.title: Request Rate by Endpoint
panels.description: HTTP request rate broken down by route — shows which endpoints are under load during chaos scenarios

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Name
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Error Rate (4xx / 5xx)
panels.description: HTTP error rate by status code class — spikes during HTTP 500 and exception storm chaos scenarios

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResultCode startswith "4"
| summarize count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ResultCode startswith "5"
| summarize count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Request Latency (P50 / P95 / P99)
panels.description: Request duration percentiles — P99 spikes during slow API and dependency timeout chaos scenarios

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize P50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50) / 1000.0 by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95) / 1000.0 by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

AppRequests
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize P99 = percentile(DurationMs, 99) / 1000.0 by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Process CPU time rate — spikes dramatically during CPU spike chaos scenario

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "process.cpu.time"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize CPU = avg(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Memory Usage
panels.description: Process working set memory — grows steadily during memory leak chaos scenario until OOM kill

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "dotnet.process.memory.working_set"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize Memory = avg(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: GC Collections
panels.description: Garbage collection rate by generation — increases under memory pressure

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "dotnet.gc.collections"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Thread Pool Threads
panels.description: Active thread pool threads — thread starvation visible during CPU spike and dependency timeout scenarios

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "dotnet.thread_pool.thread.count"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = avg(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Active DB Connections
panels.description: Current number of active database connections — drops to zero during DB connection failure chaos scenario

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "contosobank.db.connections.active"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = avg(Sum)

panels.title: Database Errors
panels.description: Database error rate by error type — surges during DB connection failure chaos scenario

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "contosobank.db.errors"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Dependency Timeouts
panels.description: External dependency timeout rate — spikes during dependency timeout chaos scenario (KYC provider)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "contosobank.dependency.timeouts"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Transfers (Success vs Failed)
panels.description: Transfer processing rate by outcome — failed transfers spike during HTTP 500 and exception storm chaos scenarios

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "contosobank.transfers"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Properties["status"] == "success"
| summarize value = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

AppMetrics
| where Name == "contosobank.transfers"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Properties["status"] == "failed"
| summarize value = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Transaction Volume
panels.description: Transaction processing rate — shows overall business throughput impact during chaos scenarios

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "contosobank.transactions.processed"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Exceptions & Log Volume
panels.description: Exception rate by type and log entry rate — exception storm shows diverse exception types; log flooding shows volume spike

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "contosobank.exceptions"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

AppMetrics
| where Name == "contosobank.log.entries"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize value = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
